body:
I have made an astounding discovery mistaking paper mulberry for sassafras I harvested from a termite eaten lightning struck tree an old creole trick, I made a kombucha tea with the bark
.  I consumed said tea and an almost immediate hot rush tingled over my body and being at a music show I melted into bliss. it lasted several hours and felt very similar to light rolling and to sassafras. I am making more tea now and since these trees grow everywhere and are more prolific than sassafras, I believe that the old creole method of harvest would also work with sassafras.
1 cup/1-oz of bark per gallon
